QUOTE: Without the opt-out it expands to `private_##member`, so a field written as `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(flags)` in a public header is actually named `private_flags`... Inside the library, `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` expands to the real `x`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the default rename to private_<member> and that defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS makes the macro expand to the real member name.
